# QuickPOS

> Cloud POS for Pakistan retail — checkout, inventory, customers (khata/loyalty), and reports.

QuickPOS helps store owners run calmer counters with clearer daily numbers. Starter is free for one store; Premium is custom for multi-store.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://pos-saas-kappa.vercel.app/): Product overview, workflow, FAQ
- [Features](https://pos-saas-kappa.vercel.app/features): Checkout, inventory, customers, reports, team, receipts, payments, multi-store
- [Industries](https://pos-saas-kappa.vercel.app/industries): Grocery, fashion, pharmacy, F&B, multi-store
- [Pricing](https://pos-saas-kappa.vercel.app/pricing): Free Starter and Premium custom quote
- [About](https://pos-saas-kappa.vercel.app/about): Company and customer stories
- [Contact](https://pos-saas-kappa.vercel.app/contact): Sales and support (Multan, Pakistan)
